arg.name: verbose
arg.description: Whether more debug output should be printed.

arg.name: unpause
arg.description: Whether the simulation should be unpaused on start.

arg.name: render_offscreen
arg.description: Whether offscreen rendering should be enabled.

arg.name: no_render
arg.description: Set to true to disabling rendering on- and off screen. (shorthand for render_offscreen:=false headless:=true)

arg.name: eval_mode
arg.description: Whether to run mujoco_ros in evaluation mode.

arg.name: admin_hash
arg.description: Hash to verify critical operations in evaluation mode.

arg.name: debug
arg.description: Whether to run with gdb.

arg.name: debug_server
arg.description: Whether to run with gdbserver on port 1234

arg.name: valgrind
arg.description: Whether to run with valgrind

arg.name: valgrind_args
arg.description: arguments for valgrind

arg.name: wait_for_xml
arg.description: Whether mujoco_ros should wait for an xml in the parameter server.

arg.name: realtime
arg.description: Fraction of desired realtime (0,1]. -1 to run as fast as possible.

arg.name: profile
arg.description: Whether mujoco_ros should be profiled.

arg.name: mujoco_plugin_config
arg.description: Optionally provide the path to a yaml with plugin configurations to load.

arg.name: mujoco_threads
arg.description: Deprecated. Number of threads to use in the MuJoCo simulation. Values greater than 1 can increase CPU usage because MuJoCo worker threads busy-wait.

arg.name: gdb_term_cmd
arg.description: Command to open gdb in a new terminal. Common alternative: 'xterm -e '

arg.name: modelfile
arg.description: Full MuJoCo model when description bundle unused. With urdf_source set: world MJCF to compose into (empty = built-in default_world).

arg.name: initial_joint_states
arg.description: Provide a filepath containing initial joint states to load.

arg.name: console_config_file
arg.description: Path to ROS console config used when verbose logging is active.

arg.name: urdf_source
arg.description: URDF source kind: 'file' or 'topic'. Empty skips the description bundle.

arg.name: urdf_path
arg.description: URDF file path when urdf_source:=file.

arg.name: urdf_topic
arg.description: Topic publishing URDF as a latched std_msgs/String when urdf_source:=topic. Server defaults to robot_description if unset.

arg.name: srdf_source
arg.description: Optional. SRDF source kind: 'file' or 'topic'.

arg.name: srdf_path
arg.description: SRDF file path when srdf_source:=file.

arg.name: srdf_topic
arg.description: Topic publishing SRDF as a latched std_msgs/String when srdf_source:=topic. Server defaults to robot_description_semantic if unset.

arg.name: convert_ascii_stl
arg.description: Optional. 'true'/'false' for description.convert_ascii_stl (ASCII STL → temp binary cache). Empty = false (OBJ fallback).

set_env.if: $(eval '\'$(var debug)\' != \'true\' and \'$(var debug_server)\' != \'true\' and \'$(var valgrind)\' != \'true\' and \'$(var profile)\' == \'true\'')
set_env.name: CPUPROFILE

node.args: --admin-hash $(var admin_hash) --ros-args --log-level mujoco_server:=$(var log_level) --log-level mujoco_ros_plugin_loader:=$(var log_level) --log-level Viewer:=$(var log_level)
